jobs.title: Software Product Owner
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
If you are looking for an opportunity to further your experience as a Product Owner to accelerate new and exciting software products to market, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. We are seeking a Software Product Owner who can translate customer needs and product requirements into actionable development tasks. You will be part of a global user interface team that develops software interfaces for our digital instrumentation using human centered design principles.
Our Software performs diagnostic testing and offers recommended repair actions to assist users in maintaining their fleet of control valves. In this role, you will implement product requirements from the defined product roadmap as new sensors, communication technologies, and data sources become available.

AS A SOFTWARE PRODUCT OWNER, YOU WILL:
- Be an advocate for the customer to improve the user experience design
- Work directly with our software engineering development and test teams to refine and implement functional requirements
- Support global product launches and release activities
- Communicate product management activities to all levels of the organization as the product owner
- Reference product roadmap to prioritize, socialize and implement software enhancement with software development and test teams
- Customer-focused mindset for delivering a product that provides a great customer experience
- Constantly look for ways to increase the team's velocity/productivity by eliminating waste and identifying creative ways to accelerate delivery timelines
- Help build and maintain high team morale
- Partner with the Product Manager to ensure alignment with requirements and priorities
- Facilitation skills – ability to lead small to medium groups of internal stakeholders towards desired outcomes to meet business objectives

WHO YOU ARE:
You identify and seize new opportunities. You build and deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations. You engage in collaborative planning and development. You are a great communicator.

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE & SKILLS:
- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science or Software Development or a Marketing degree with product management emphasis or equivalent work experience.
- 3 to 7 years’ experience in a software product owner role or equivalent
- Ability to travel up to 10%
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint

PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE & SKILLS:
- Experience with Agile development methodologies

Familiarity with Requirements Management Software (e.g. Jama) and development task management

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career in Product Management, this role offers the chance to join a globally impactful portfolio, shaping the future of industrial valve solutions. We are seeking a Product Manager to develop strategies for new products and solutions within an industry-leading business unit. In this role, you will identify market opportunities, define product strategies, develop business cases, and help drive sales and profitability growth.
Working closely with customers, sales teams, marketing teams, and engineering teams across the globe, you will identify, define, and develop innovative product concepts that expand market share and address critical customer needs within the isolation valve industry.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
- Monitor and communicate global market dynamics, including segment growth, emerging opportunities, industry trends, strategic account developments, competitive intelligence, and competitive product offerings to assess potential business impact.
- Analyze adjacent market opportunities and potential acquisition targets.
- Conduct market research and voice-of-customer activities to develop market requirements and customer value propositions for current and future products and features.
- Travel to customer locations and sales channel partners to gain direct insight into customer challenges, applications, and business needs.
- Identify target market opportunities and develop compelling business cases to support investment decisions.
- Develop business plans and define, refine, and maintain product requirements for new products identified through market research, ensuring alignment with market needs and effective communication to engineering teams.
- Communicate product vision, target market strategy, and project progress to stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Leadership to gather feedback and maintain alignment.
- Develop marketing collateral, product bulletins, and training materials for newly released products.
- Analyze key business metrics, including bookings, market participation, run rates, quote conversion rates, and other performance indicators, and recommend corrective actions as appropriate.

Who You Are:
You anticipate future possibilities and translate them into breakthrough strategies that create customer value and drive business results. You build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions while balancing multiple priorities and making sense of complex and sometimes contradictory information. You work collaboratively across organizational boundaries, building partnerships and fostering an environment where diverse perspectives contribute to successful outcomes.
For This Role, You Will Need:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
- Five (5) years or more of experience in marketing, sales, business development, product management, product marketing, or a related field.
- Experience conducting market research and translating customer insights into business opportunities and product requirements.
- Experience developing business cases, product strategies, or go-to-market plans.
- Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively across technical, commercial, and leadership audiences.
- Ability to develop and maintain strong global working relationships.
- Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
- MBA or advanced business degree.
- Experience in technical sales, market analysis, product management, or business development within the industrial automation market.
- Knowledge of industrial valve products, applications, customers, and competitive landscapes.
- Understanding of the commercial and technical applications of isolation valves or similar industrial products.
- Experience evaluating adjacent market opportunities and acquisition targets.
- Experience developing financial models and business case evaluations.

Our Culture & Commitment to You
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is
valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact . We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement,
employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

jobs.title: Product Management Director
jobs.description:
If you are a Director, Global Product Management professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you in Novi, MI. In this strategic leadership role, you will define and execute the global product vision and portfolio strategy for Branson’s advanced joining and precision cleaning technologies. Reporting to the Vice President, Strategic Business Unit, you will lead the full product lifecycle, from market insight and portfolio strategy to new product development, pricing, commercialization, and product lifecycle optimization. Working closely with global teams across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and regional organizations, you will play a key role in driving innovation, profitable growth, and long-term business success.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
- Define and execute a global product portfolio strategy aligned with business objectives, growth priorities, and market opportunities.
- Develop and maintain short-, mid-, and long-term product roadmaps informed by customer insights, market trends, emerging technologies, and business performance.
- Build and manage a complementary product portfolio that supports global and regional growth while minimizing internal overlap.
- Lead product lifecycle management activities, including product introductions, enhancements, portfolio rationalization, and end-of-life planning.
- Evaluate buy, build, and partner opportunities through strategic, commercial, and financial analysis.
- Monitor portfolio performance, including orders, revenue, profitability, pricing, and product mix, and drive actions that improve business results.
- Develop business cases and investment recommendations for new product development initiatives, including return on investment and financial impact analysis.
- Own global pricing strategies and partner with regional teams to drive pricing execution, profitability, and value-based selling.
- Lead product management activities within new product development programs, including business case development, requirements definition, and cross-functional alignment.
- Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure successful product launches and commercialization efforts.
- Lead market intelligence initiatives, including competitive analysis, market segmentation, customer research, voice-of-customer programs, and win/loss evaluations.
- Translate market trends, customer needs, and industry developments into actionable product strategies and portfolio investments.
- Support global go-to-market strategies through product positioning, sales enablement, customer engagement, and marketing collaboration.
- Develop, coach, and lead a geographically distributed team of product management professionals.
- Establish product management best practices, governance processes, and portfolio review frameworks that promote continuous improvement and business excellence.

Who You Are:
You anticipate future possibilities and translate them into breakthrough strategies that create long-term value. You communicate complex information clearly and effectively across functions, regions, and organizational levels to drive alignment and informed decision-making. You develop and deliver solutions that meet customer needs while balancing diverse stakeholder interests and business priorities. You foster innovation by encouraging new ideas, challenging conventional thinking, and creating an environment where individuals and teams can grow, contribute, and achieve meaningful results.
For This Role, You Will Need:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
- Significant experience in product management, product marketing, business development, or a related commercial leadership role within an industrial business environment.
- Experience leading product management teams in a global or multi-regional setting.
- Demonstrated success managing complex product portfolios throughout the product lifecycle, including product launches, optimization, and retirement planning.
- Experience developing and executing product strategies that drive growth, profitability, and customer value.
- Strong financial acumen with experience developing business cases, evaluating investments, and supporting portfolio decision-making.
- Experience collaborating effectively with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Marketing teams.
- Strong analytical, strategic thinking, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 30%.
- Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
- Legal authorization to work in the United States – sponsorship will not be provided.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
- MBA or advanced degree in a related discipline.
- Experience with advanced joining technologies, ultrasonic welding, vibration welding, precision cleaning systems, plastics joining, automation technologies, or related industrial markets.
- Experience developing and executing global pricing and profitability strategies.
- Knowledge of product lifecycle management, stage-gate methodologies, and new product development processes.
- Experience conducting market analysis, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer research.
- Proficiency with CRM, ERP, PLM, or related business systems.
- Proficiency in an additional language such as German, Mandarin, or Spanish.
- Experience serving automotive, medical, electronics, consumer goods, or industrial manufacturing markets.

Our Culture and Commitment To You:
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
At Emerson, our values of Integrity, Safety & Quality, Support Our People, Customer Focus, Continuous Improvement, Collaboration, and Innovation guide everything we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives are valued. We recognize that strong teams are built through different ideas and approaches, and we encourage candidates who can contribute to our culture of learning, innovation, and continuous growth to apply.

The Director, Global Product Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining and executing Branson's global product vision across its full portfolio of ultrasonic, vibration welding, and related advanced joining and precision cleaning technologies. Reporting to the Vice President of Sales & Business Unit, this leader owns the entire product lifecycle, from market insight and portfolio strategy through new product development, pricing, launch, and end-of-life management. The Director also serves as a key driver of Branson's innovation agenda and Emerson's broader growth strategy.

jobs.description:
